title: STS2 Tracker v1.3.5 - Mandatory Leaderboard Authentication & Profile Deduplication
changelog: Enforced Leaderboard Auth: Requires explicit sign-in or Slayer Handle selection before syncing climb records to the Global Leaderboard
Eliminated Default Slayers: Removed synthetic SteamSlayer_XXXX fallback usernames; leaderboard only ranks verified accounts
Profile Deduplication: Merged duplicate SteamSlayer entries into confirmed player handles (Kratos77x and volodia)
Competitive Integrity: Filtered out defeat runs and missing player records from global competitive tables
notes: Enforces authentication before leaderboard syncing, removes synthetic SteamSlayer profiles, and merges verified player records.
